label: Vendor Comparison
description: Compare vendors against requirements, cost, risk, security, and operational fit.

classifier.useWhen: User asks which vendor/tool/provider is a better fit.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for pure product marketing copy.

label: RFP Writing
description: Draft request-for-proposal questions, scoring criteria, and response templates.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to create an RFP, vendor questionnaire, or procurement checklist.

label: Purchasing Requirements
description: Define purchasing, security, legal, operational, and commercial requirements.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what requirements to give vendors or evaluate against.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a sales pitch.

label: Commercial Contract Review
description: Review commercial contract terms such as pricing, renewal, SLA, and termination from a business perspective.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about commercial terms or vendor contract tradeoffs.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for binding legal advice.

label: Security Questionnaire
description: Draft or review vendor security questionnaire content.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for security questionnaire support.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for internal security incident response.

label: Vendor Scorecard
description: Build vendor scoring criteria, weights, and summaries.

label: Renewal Review
description: Review renewal timing, pricing, usage, risk, and negotiation points.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether to renew a vendor.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal final approval.

label: SLA Review
description: Review service levels, support terms, penalties, and operational fit.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for uptime incident triage.

label: Negotiation Plan
description: Prepare vendor negotiation strategy, asks, and fallback positions.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to negotiate vendor terms.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for sales objection handling.

label: Purchase Justification
description: Draft justification for purchase, renewal, or vendor selection.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to justify buying something.
